title: Batch-to-Streaming Bridge: One Lake for Both Pipelines
title_es: Puente Batch-Streaming: Un Solo Lago para Ambos Pipelines
description: Runnable batch-to-streaming bridge examples: a partitioned lake, shared-schema producers, a speed layer and serving-layer dedup in Python and JavaScript with tests.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables del puente batch-streaming: un lago particionado, productores de esquema compartido, capa speed y dedup en capa de servicio en Python y JavaScript con tests.
